flow-seam.blurb: one act leaves on an axis, a frame of empty ground, the next arrives on the same axis, ground colour shifts

sources.note: editor window exits left, 'MADERA understands' enters from the right
tagline exits left, product card enters from the right, ground darkens
card exits left over a warm brown ground, ground lightens back to grey, 'find' enters from the right
tagline exits up, ground shifts olive-grey, a tilted window rises from the bottom
window exits up, ground returns to light grey, a shape rises from the bottom

slots.at: seconds: the seam's measured joint (core midpoint of the empty-ground frames)
slots.ground: [outgoing ground id, incoming ground id], optional

axis.note: measured per source: x on 3 of 5 (right-to-left), y on 2 of 5 (bottom-to-top). madera changes axis once, after its 3rd seam

gap.note: core empty-ground span, measured 0.05s to 0.1s (3 to 6 frames @60fps) across the five seams

groundFade.note: not directly measured here (this study reads the seam, not the enter/exit tween durations); carried forward from the prior recipes.json entry

flow-exit-enter.blurb: the incoming element after a flow-seam arrives from the seam's own axis and direction, mirroring the outgoing element's exit

sources.note: 'MADERA understands' enters from the right (x axis) as the window exits left
the tilted window enters from the bottom (y axis) as the tagline exits up

direction.note: measured centroid comparison, ~0.25s either side of the seam's core
